verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions server-side SDKs and a SIP interconnect feature for connecting sessions to SIP gateways. Neither shows a server-side agent joining a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime. The SIP gateway connection is an adjacent capability, and the server-side SDKs are not documented as media-capable participants, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a server-side agent joins a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime
